telemetry.sql: CREATE TABLE telemetry (event_id String, time String, source String, sourcetype String, harness String, event String) ENGINE=Memory; INSERT INTO telemetry SELECT * FROM file('<validated telemetry JSONL>', 'JSONEachRow', 'event_id String, time String, source String, sourcetype String, harness String, event String'); SELECT source, event, count() AS events FROM telemetry GROUP BY source,event ORDER BY source,event SETTINGS output_format_json_quote_64bit_integers=0
telemetry.note: Mock/observed event counts are operational inputs, never independent model trials.

execution: Simulated records tools; no external sends
scope: One fixed records-assistant task; not the registered frontend source code
recommendation: No schema-sensitive committed-ASR difference observed in this small cohort. Keep the execution boundary; do not interpret zero observed commits as proof of safety.
limitations: Five trials per variant, one task/model, simulated execution. No benign model-utility evaluation or causal claim.
